pages.text: Makes plain vanilla honeycomb. Its gem needs a full set of iron armour (damaged armour is fine). Counts toward the Royal Summoning.$(br2)$(l)Flowers:$() any flower$(br2)$(l)Home biome:$() none$(br2)$(l)Brings home$() (busy hive):$(li)Honeycomb: every trip, 210 per hive-hour

$(l)Royal guard:$() Waxes nearby copper, protects bees and players, survives stinging, and mugs anyone who hits it or a bee nearby (one sting of 1.5 hearts every 2.5 seconds while it mugs). Attacks dark bees on sight.
Use it on a vanilla bee.
